The supplied data do not establish capacity for 45 people, the usable-area layout, or authorization and technical feasibility for conversion, so these require verification. The regulatory source gives a 465 sqm useful covered design model for 45 places, with a stated ±10% variation; this is not a gross-area threshold. The 7.6 and 8.0 sqm figures apply to specified child spaces, not the whole property. Applicable rules at the time of application and the listed planning, building, health, accessibility, fire-safety, structural, and sector authorization checks should be confirmed. The deterministic relevance score is 65.
pros: Existing school and educational use is closely aligned with nursery conversion.
Reported gross floor area of 6,663.31 sqm exceeds the requested 600 sqm.
Energy class C meets the requested D-or-better threshold; green proximity is high at 96.12.
cons: Capacity for 45 people and suitability of the internal layout are not established by the supplied data.
The 465 sqm 45-place model is useful covered area, not gross area; actual usable area and room provision need assessment.
Planning compatibility, change-of-use approval, and applicable health, accessibility, safety, structural, and sector authorization requirements remain to be checked.
